modeling_role: Defines what rows of the feature matrix represent
review_requirement: Document sampling process inclusion rules time period unit of analysis missing records and measurement context
responsible_use_warning: Rows may reflect biased sampling institutional visibility exclusion or uneven data collection

modeling_role: Defines what each model input column measures or encodes
review_requirement: Record units provenance transformations proxies missingness and known limitations
responsible_use_warning: Features can encode proxy variables historical bias measurement artifacts and institutional decisions

modeling_role: Defines the outcome or label the model learns to predict
review_requirement: Document label source timing measurement process subjectivity delay and relationship to the decision
responsible_use_warning: A predictive target is not automatically a valid decision target

review_requirement: Document scaling centering imputation encoding normalization projection feature selection and fitted parameters
responsible_use_warning: Preprocessing changes feature geometry and can leak information if fit outside the training process

modeling_role: Prevents validation or test data from influencing training
review_requirement: Fit preprocessing feature selection dimensionality reduction model parameters and thresholds inside training or validation workflows only
responsible_use_warning: Leakage can make model performance appear much better than it will be in deployment

modeling_role: Defines the reference model used to judge added complexity
review_requirement: Train transparent baselines and compare complex models against them using the same evaluation protocol
responsible_use_warning: Complexity should not be added without evidence that it improves validated decision-relevant performance

review_requirement: Report overall metrics residuals calibration threshold sensitivity subgroup error rare-event performance and temporal validation
responsible_use_warning: Average metrics can hide concentrated failure unequal error and decision harm

modeling_role: Defines how deployment behavior is checked over time
review_requirement: Monitor feature drift label shift concept drift embedding drift residual drift data pipeline changes and retraining triggers
responsible_use_warning: A valid training-time model can become invalid when data behavior policy or the environment changes

modeling_role: Defines what the model can and cannot support
review_requirement: Attach documentation uncertainty validation status threshold rationale oversight appeals and stop-use conditions to outputs
responsible_use_warning: Machine learning predictions should support accountable judgment not replace responsibility
